title: A Contact for the Extraction
author: Casper Eriksen
blurb: August Galloway, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
